channels.name: Kick In
channels.notes: Beta 91A/52A kick blend — 91A is the attack/click layer. Treat the pair as ONE: same VCA, pan together, blend constant. Polarity: sum in mono, flip on one mic if thinner. Bus: notch -2/-3 dB @300-500 if it builds.
channels.mic_notes: Boundary mic inside the kick — the attack engine; let it own the click, keep its lows tucked under the 52A.
channels.eq_summary: +4@3k beater definition that travels outdoors (eased from +5 — pop-soul punch, not a metal click). Lows modest so they don't stack with the 52A. 250 box cut eased to -3: open air has far less low-mid buildup than a room.

channels.name: Kick Out
channels.notes: Beta 91A/52A kick blend — 52A is the body/punch core. Treat the pair as one; pan together, same VCA.
channels.eq_summary: +5@80 supports the weight open air swallows; small 3k snap (the 91A carries the real click). Mud cut eased for outdoors.

channels.name: Snare Top
channels.mic_notes: i5 has a built-in ~3.5k presence peak + scooped mids; more body, less boxy than an SM57.
channels.eq_summary: Crack boost small (+3@1k) and box cut -5 not -7 — the capsule isn't boxy, don't gut it. +2@7k snap to cut outdoors; -2@5.5k tames ring.

channels.name: Hat
channels.eq_summary: No HF boost needed; just clear the low bleed (800) and the 2k clang so it sparkles without harshness.

channels.name: Rack 1
channels.mic_notes: D2 is tuned to control tom resonance; articulate with little EQ.
channels.eq_summary: Attack lift eased to +4 — trust the capsule; gentle body, modest mud cut.

channels.name: Rack 2
channels.mic_notes: As Rack 1, shifted down for the larger drum.
channels.eq_summary: Let the D2 do the work.

channels.name: Floor
channels.mic_notes: D4 reaches an octave lower than the D2 natively.
channels.eq_summary: Body shelf stays modest (+4) — support, not a big lift; ride the sub outdoors. Attack at 1.8k for stick definition.

channels.name: OH HL
channels.eq_summary: +3@5k eased from +5 — SM81 is already detailed; a big lift gets brittle over a long outdoor throw. 300 clears low wash.

channels.name: OH HR
channels.mic_notes: Matched to OH HL — keep the stereo pair identical.

channels.name: Bass DI
channels.notes: Bass DI + SM57 cab blend: DI = weight + low-mid warmth, 57 = punch + air. Group to one VCA, polarity-check against the 57.
channels.mic_notes: DI carries the lows the cab mic can't.
channels.eq_summary: Soul/Motown bass = dark, round, low-mid forward, top rolled. +5@600 is the Motown 'wool'; -5@1.5k tames string clank; -6@250 keeps it off the kick/cab; +5@80 foundation.

channels.name: Bass Mic
channels.notes: Blend with the DI — see Bass DI note.
channels.mic_notes: 57 rolls off below ~200 — not a low source; it's the punch/air mid layer over the DI.
channels.eq_summary: +5@900 grind; -7@400 carves a pocket so it doesn't double the DI mud. LPF 5k keeps the dark soul character.

channels.name: Guitar 57
channels.notes: SM57/Beta 27 blend — 57 owns mids, 27 owns air + body. Don't double the 2.5k. Same VCA, polarity-check.
channels.mic_notes: 57 owns the mid grit + presence core.
channels.eq_summary: Dreamy/supportive guitar (not a rock wall): mid boosts eased so it sits under the vocal. Box at 450; 200 cleared so it doesn't stack with the 27's body.

channels.name: Guitar 27
channels.notes: SM57/Beta 27 blend — 27 carries the air + clean body the 57 lacks.
channels.mic_notes: Bright detailed condenser — value is the air + clean low body the 57 lacks.
channels.eq_summary: Re-thought from a KB default: instead of doubling the 57 at 2.5k, give it air at 9k + clean body at 120 and stay out of the mids. 57 owns mids, 27 owns air+body — no doubling.

channels.name: Acoustic Guitar
channels.mic_notes: AR-133 is clean/transparent; the source is a piezo — quack at 1-3k, brassy at ~5k.
channels.eq_summary: Biggest fix vs the KB default: air moved OFF 5k (that's the brassy piezo zone you cut) up to 8k. The -6@2k quack cut made DYNAMIC so it only bites on loud strums without gutting sustain; -5@400 box; +4@200 body the piezo lacks.

channels.name: Keys
channels.mic_notes: Piano is central to her writing.
channels.eq_summary: Warmth (+3@300) + a little clarity (+4@2.5k, eased) without hype; -5@200 clears mud so it doesn't crowd the bass + vocal low-mids.

channels.name: Click
channels.eq_summary: Mud trimmed so it's clean in the players' ears. CONFIRM: monitors / IEM only — never assigned to FOH.

channels.name: Guide
channels.eq_summary: Same utility treatment. CONFIRM: monitors / IEM only — not in FOH.

channels.name: Tracks
channels.mic_notes: Mastered, full-range stem (her lush strings/synths/BGV bed).
channels.eq_summary: Re-thought: it's already balanced — EQ'ing it like a mic'd source thins the production. Left near-flat (HPF 30 only). Add a small 315 trim live ONLY if it clouds the band.

channels.name: Izzy
channels.mic_notes: KMS 105 — transparent, smooth 7-12k presence, NOT a sibilant mic. Wired handheld on a stand (not the wireless system).
channels.eq_summary: The show lives here. Killed the static -5@8k for a DYNAMIC de-ess that only acts on sibilant peaks — keep the air a soul voice wants. HPF pulled to 110 (mic compensates proximity, won't boom) to protect the throaty Winehouse chest body. -3@1.6k gentle nasal; -4@300 box for outdoor intelligibility. Protective + subtractive, not aggressive. NOTE: this overrides the template's wireless vocal baseline (removes its -18@5k feedback notch) — watch for feedback at soundcheck; reach for the Mustard comp + a touch of plate before any more EQ.

artist_profile: Cuban-Italian pop-soul / indie-R&B singer-songwriter (debut EP 'Sunny in London', 2025). Classically trained on violin, piano-forward writing, lush but RESTRAINED production. Voice is the show: Amy-Winehouse throaty grit meets Adele-style soulful power, wide dynamic range from intimate/breathy to commanding belt. FOH implication: protect the low-mid chest body, ride/compress for the intimate->belt swing, keep EQ subtractive and musical, de-ess dynamically rather than statically cutting the air.
research_summary: Artist: Billboard, Atwood Magazine, commfailure EP review, izzyescobarmusic.com -> pop-soul/indie-R&B, restraint over maximalism, Winehouse+Adele vocal reference. Per-source EQ: live forum/maker consensus (Sound on Sound, Gearspace, Pro Sound Web, Shure, Premier Guitar, Harman) cross-checked vs the KB eq-starting-points + each mic's profile. Venue: open-air Fountain Square — no room gain, low end + HF dissipate, facade slap but no reverb tail.
reverb_note: FSQ is outdoors — default is no reverb send. Vocal: short, forward plate only if the song calls for it.
